key_insight: A thermodynamically consistent phase-field model couples donor–acceptor phase separation, solvent evaporation, and fluid motion during organic solar-cell active-layer formation.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support analysis of how drying and flow influence active-layer morphology in organic photovoltaic manufacturing.
method: Couple incompressible Navier–Stokes, degenerate multispecies Cahn–Hilliard, and Allen–Cahn equations.
Include cross-diffusion and a variational formulation of diffusion fluxes.
Prove global-in-time weak-solution existence and total-energy dissipation without size constraints on the data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical guarantees, not experimental validation, numerical benchmarks, or AI-based evaluation.
watch_item: Degenerate mobility requires a specialized variational treatment of diffusion fluxes, which may complicate numerical implementation.
paper_title: Modeling and analysis of a phase-field model for organic solar cells
